notes.title: 2021 Major Update and Sunday Group Play Event
notes.content:
A new update for 2021 has been released in the past week.  A fun playthrough by Waterflame and pftq can be watched below showing much of the new changes.  We'll also have a group play session this coming Sunday at 2PM PT for people to explore the map together and battle it out in Zero-G again.  Join us online if you can or feel free to watch in the livestream (Twitch.tv/VRJetpackGame)
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2mZM1NdzQTg


The major changes include the menus, tutorial dome, boost rings, and generally the map feels much bigger and more open now.  A full list is below:
- Added tutorial dome with AI voice guide by Waterflame as the starting point.
- Redesigned ground-level to be broken up and more open.  Removed city/cliffs for more openness.
- Restored large floating island with clouds/waterfall from earlier version of game.
- Lifted max-height of flying to space-station level.
- Added clouds to floating space station.
- Added asteroid field between space station and large floating island.
- Added giant planet and mech in horizon for aesthetics.
- Added boost rings around map similar to Sonic games. Credits to Avari for the model.
- Added auto-rotate to any surface and stand upside down or sideways on planets or in Zero-G.
- Slight randomization of gunshot/sonic-burst sounds for variation.
- Proper menus for both VR and non-VR matching the menu music video with tower and clouds.

notes.title: Aug.7 5PM PT Free-for-All and ELO Ladder Now Online
notes.content:
The Zero-G ladder is now up at [url=https://vrjetpackgame.com/ladder/]https://vrjetpackgame.com/ladder/[/url] .  Games played at the Zero-G arena above the tower automatically get recorded and calculated for rankings.  We'll gradually keep building on this to show player and match history as well.

Tomorrow (Aug.7) at 5PM PT is also another in-game session hosted by Waterflame and pftq.  We'll be meeting at the Zero-G arena itself (you can press Z or controller trigger at the startup menu to spawn there).  Come join us to get matches in and meet new players.  Both VR and non-VR players are welcome.

There will also be a few surprise features/abilities added to the game geared towards team combat.  Some of them will be downright goofy but fun to use.  Expect to see them in the battles tomorrow.

notes.title: Performance Improvements and Starting at Zero-G
notes.content:
Latest build just released should give a nice bump up to framerate.  On an RTX 2060, I'm able to keep near 90 FPS most parts of the map (the city being the main exception as it has the most detail and is hard to optimize).  Anything above the tower should easily stay at 90 FPS and has been that way even before this update (because there are no clouds / rocks / terrain up there).

Gameplay-wise, you can also now start at the Zero-G arena by hitting Z at the server select menu.  Just be sure you have your flying and swinging skills mastered, as other players there will be battling for rank and likely have no mercy. :P 

Speaking of which, we will be starting our weekly group meetup at the Zero-G arena in a few minutes for those who want to join and battle with a bunch of players.  After that, we'll also enter the new wormhole that takes you to outerspace to battle an enemy fleet.  

As always, feel free to watch on the live-stream if you cannot join us in-game!

For a tip of how to get to the new location, this quote from the movie is applicable in a pretty silly way: "Newton's third law – the only way humans have ever figured out of getting somewhere is to leave something behind."

notes.title: Steam Festival Demo
notes.content:
Demo is out for the Steam Game Festival from Jun 16-22. The map is still work-in-progress, but it should be enough to get a feel for how the mechanics work - flying, swinging, etc. For now, multiplayer is only up for US/Europe (and Europe only certain times, check Discord below). If a server is not up in your location, you're welcome to try and join the US one, but do so at your own risk and likely heavy lag (just physical limitation of how fast data can go across the world).  Single-player mode is always available though if you just want to get the feel of flying.

There's a Discord channel for voice-chat in game as a temporary solution until in-game chat is done.  We'll also post updates (such as server availability) there and answer questions. Those without VR can watch players on Twitch or join the game to watch in spectator mode. 

Links to everything (Discord, Twitch, etc) can be found at [url=https://www.vrjetpackgame.com/]https://www.vrjetpackgame.com/[/url]
